entries.56fefbfed855a03d: In the pachinko machine-related business, the company achieved its target of a unit sales share of 30% or more and has held the top share for four consecutive periods. In the pachislot machine-related business, it has also held a double-digit unit sales share for two consecutive years. Under the company motto of "Sōi-kufu" (creative ingenuity), it has strengths in offering original products, and it has a one-stop service structure that can also provide products necessary for hall operations, including dispensing equipment.

entries.66d497c454c3ea14: As its basic philosophy, the company states that it aims to fulfill its mission as a leading company in the pachinko and pachislot industry in order to contribute to the healthy development of leisure and the creation of a spiritually rich society. The company aims to concentrate its management resources on gaming machine-related businesses, and to revitalize the gaming industry and improve corporate value on a sustained basis. The company announced on May 9, 2024 a three-year medium-term management plan starting with the fiscal year ended March 2025, and is also working to create new businesses centered on the development of secondary-use content for gaming machines and the creation and development of content IP, including manga and anime.
